newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-DUTCH STAND-IN COACH MAKES ONE CHANGE FOR FRANCE FRIENDLY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DUTCH STAND-IN COACH MAKES ONE CHANGE FOR FRANCE FRIENDLY.

text.p: The Netherlands named a largely unchanged squad on Thursday for a friendly against France in Paris next Wednesday.
Jan Rab, 53 and the Dutch soccer board's head of coaching, stands in for Guus Hiddink who is recovering from a stomach operation.
Among the players, there is just one change from the squad that beat neighbours Belgium 3-0 in a World Cup qualifier in December.
Feyenoord midfielder Jean-Paul van Gastel, back after a broken leg, replaces Aaron Winter who is on club duty for Inter Milan.
Goalkeepers - Edwin van der Sar (Ajax Amsterdam), Ed de Goey (Feyenoord).
Defenders - Frank de Boer (Ajax), Michael Reiziger (AC Milan), Arthur Numan, Jaap Stam, Stan Valckx (all PSV), Ferdy Vierklau (Vitesse).
Midfielders - Ronald de Boer (Ajax) Giovanni van Bronckhorst, Jean-Paul van Gastel (both Feyenoord), Philip Cocu, Wim Jonk (both PSV), Clarence Seedorf (Real Madrid).
Forwards - Patrick Kluivert, Marc Overmars (both Ajax), Dennis Bergkamp (Arsenal), Pierre van Hooijdonk (Celtic).
